title: A mystery QR code on the parking meter
scenario: The parking meter has an 'Out of Order - Scan to Pay' sticker with a QR code. Scanning it opens a payment page asking for your card number, expiry date, and CVV.

answers.A: Skip the QR code and pay through the official parking app or the meter's card reader instead.
answers.B: Scan it, but only enter the last four digits of your card.
answers.C: Scan it and pay - it's faster than finding the app.

explanation: Fraudulent QR stickers placed over real parking signage are a fast-growing scam. The 'out of order' framing exists to push you toward the fake link instead of the official option.
proTip: A sticker QR code on public equipment is never the safest way to pay - use the app or the machine itself.
